comment: Candidate pool for the Power Rankings. compute-buzz.mjs measures each spot's Reddit mentions and Google review velocity, then ranks the top 5. Add or remove spots freely — aliases are the search terms used for Reddit matching. Optional `opened` (YYYY-MM, approximate is fine) gives recently opened spots a newcomer boost: ×1.2 under 4 months, ×1.1 under 8.
